name: RemoteMachine
shortDescription: Connect to Windows, Mac and Linux with RDP, SSH and VNC in a free Windows workspace with movable fullscreen controls.
description:
Windows. Mac. Linux. One workspace.

RemoteMachine is a free native Windows app for organizing remote computers and working across RDP, SSH and VNC. Keep sessions together and switch between machines without reconnecting. There is no trial, subscription, advertising or in-app purchase.

FULLSCREEN WITHOUT A FIXED CONNECTION BAR
A movable edge handle reveals your session controls without permanently covering the remote desktop. Move it to another edge, fit a session inside the app, or use the recovery shortcuts: Ctrl+Alt+Space shows controls and Ctrl+Alt+Home returns to the manager.

CONNECT USING THE RIGHT PROTOCOL
- Windows: Microsoft RDP for PCs with Remote Desktop enabled.
- Mac: VNC using built-in macOS Screen Sharing; no extra Mac software is needed for this path.
- Linux and other SSH hosts: embedded OpenSSH terminals. SSH opens a shell, not a graphical desktop.
- Other compatible desktops: connect using their supported RDP or VNC server.

A WORKSPACE THAT STAYS YOURS
Organize local profiles with groups, favorites and search. Expand Work, Home or Cloud to switch between active sessions. Import and export standard-PC .rdp profiles. Choose System, Light or Dark appearance and adjust VNC mouse-wheel sensitivity per connection.

REQUIREMENTS
RemoteMachine runs on Windows 11, x64 or ARM64. Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is required for SSH and VNC; Windows OpenSSH Client is required for SSH. Remote computers must have the appropriate server enabled and be reachable on your network. The app is a client, not a remote-access server or cloud relay. The .NET runtime is included in the Store package.

IMPORTANT VNC SECURITY INFORMATION
The current VNC screen/input transport is not encrypted. Use a trusted network, VPN or independently established SSH tunnel. Never expose port 5900 directly to the internet. RemoteMachine does not create tunnels automatically.

This early version does not support Azure Dev Box / Windows App managed workspaces, RDP gateways, RemoteApp, multi-monitor spanning, VNC clipboard synchronization or file transfer. A reported Mac fullscreen hand-cursor issue is still under investigation.

Screenshots use fictional sample computers. The fullscreen remote desktop is an explicitly labeled illustration; its surrounding controls are the real app UI.
features: RDP, embedded SSH terminals and VNC in one native Windows app
Movable fullscreen controls with keyboard recovery shortcuts
Retained sessions and quick switching through Work, Home and Cloud
Local profiles, favorites, groups and standard-PC .rdp import/export
System, Light, Dark and Windows high-contrast appearance
Fit-to-window display and per-connection VNC scroll sensitivity
Completely free, without a trial, subscription, advertising or in-app purchases
fullTrustJustification: RemoteMachine is a native WPF desktop client. It embeds the installed Microsoft RDP ActiveX control, starts Windows OpenSSH through ConPTY, and uses Microsoft Edge WebView2 to render SSH and VNC sessions. It needs standard user Win32 APIs, TCP sockets, per-user profile files, local file pickers, and fullscreen window/hotkey management. It runs asInvoker, does not require administrator privileges, and does not install a service, driver or remote-access server. runFullTrust is required to run this existing desktop application, not to elevate its permissions.
certificationNotes: RemoteMachine is a free Windows 11 desktop remote-access client for x64 and ARM64. No app account, subscription, paid unlock or publisher-hosted service is required. The .NET runtime is included. SSH/VNC require Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime; SSH also requires the Windows OpenSSH Client optional feature. Test connections against your own reachable test hosts, with their RDP, SSH or VNC services enabled. RDP hosting requires a supported Windows edition. For macOS, enable Screen Sharing and authorize a local Mac account; for classic VNC use its configured VNC password. VNC is unencrypted, so use only a trusted test network, VPN or independently established tunnel. No publisher credentials or public test host are provided. Create a profile using New connection, save it, select Connect and complete the remote system's authentication. Test fullscreen recovery using Ctrl+Alt+Space and Ctrl+Alt+Home. Screenshots contain fictional profiles; the remote desktop illustration is explicitly labeled. Store builds do not expose development preview or self-test command-line modes.
